name: Carbon County, UT
findings: Carbon County has 59 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Carbon County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Carbon County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
